beats.text: Nine worlds hang from one tree,
beats.shot: wide, dusk: a colossal ash tree, nine glowing lights hung through its branches and roots, stars behind
beats.state: Yggdrasil, a giant ash tree in empty space; dusk; no figures; static wide, slow push-in

beats.text: and all of it will burn.
beats.shot: close, dusk: red cracks of light running down the huge trunk
beats.state: Yggdrasil, a giant ash tree in empty space; dusk; no figures; static wide, slow push-in
beats.trace: Voluspa 45-57 (the destruction); Gylf 4 and 51 ('burn all the world') V

beats.text: Odin knows it,
beats.shot: medium, firelit hall: Odin alone on a high seat, one eye, wide hat, looking at his own hands
beats.state: Odin's hall; night; 1 present: Odin alone; no movement
beats.trace: (ours) framing; basis Voluspa 28-30 (Odin consults the seeress)

beats.text: because a seeress told him his own ending.
beats.shot: medium, firelit hall: Odin alone, head tilted as if listening, eye half closed
beats.state: Odin's hall; night; 1 present: Odin alone; no movement

beats.text: Odin gave an eye for wisdom,
beats.shot: close: Odin's face, one bright eye, a dark empty socket on the other side
beats.state: Odin's hall; night; 1 present: Odin; close on his face, no movement

beats.text: and still could not change the ending.
beats.shot: wide: Odin alone at a cliff edge looking over a dark sea, hat brim shading his face
beats.state: cliff above a dark sea; twilight; 1 present: Odin; he stands still

beats.text: The gods chain a wolf to stop it.
beats.shot: wide, dusk: the huge grey wolf Fenrir bound to a flat rock by a thin pale ribbon, Tyr standing alone beside him
beats.state: Fenrir's rock; dusk; 2 present: Fenrir (bound), Tyr; Tyr stands still

beats.text: One of them loses a hand doing it.
beats.shot: close, dusk: Tyr alone holding up his right arm, which ends in a bandaged stump
beats.state: Fenrir's rock; dusk; 1 present: Tyr; close on his raised arm

beats.text: It makes no difference.
beats.shot: wide, dusk: Fenrir alone on his rock, the ribbon pulled tight, jaws shut
beats.state: Fenrir's rock; dusk; 1 present: Fenrir; jaws shut

beats.text: The end comes anyway,
beats.shot: wide, night: a red sky over a dark plain, tiny black silhouettes of armies on the horizon
beats.state: burnt plain; night, red sky; 0 then 3: Odin, Thor, Tyr fallen

beats.text: and almost every god dies.
beats.shot: wide, night: Odin, Thor and Tyr lying fallen on a burnt plain, smoke drifting
beats.state: burnt plain; night, red sky; 0 then 3: Odin, Thor, Tyr fallen

beats.text: So how does a world begin, and how does it end?
beats.shot: close, dawn: Odin facing us, one eye, wide hat, pale light
beats.state: Odin's hall doorway; dawn; 1 present: Odin; he faces the camera, no movement

beats.text: Let us start at the beginning.
beats.shot: wide, dawn: an empty pale-blue gap between a white ice land on the left and a red glowing land on the right
beats.state: empty pale-blue void; dawn; 0 present; slow pull-out

beats.text: In the beginning there is no sand, no sea, and no sky.
beats.shot: wide, dawn: a bare empty gap, grey and pale blue, nothing in it
beats.state: Ginnungagap, the empty gap; dawn; 0 present; static wide

beats.text: Only a great gap, with ice on one side
beats.shot: wide: the gap with a white frozen land filling the left side
beats.state: Ginnungagap, the empty gap; dawn; 0 present; static wide

beats.text: and fire on the other.
beats.shot: wide: the same gap, a red glowing land filling the right side
beats.state: Ginnungagap, the empty gap; dawn; 0 present; static wide

beats.text: Where the cold meets the heat, the ice begins to melt,
beats.shot: medium: white ice dripping into a pool on the left, red glow on the right
beats.state: the gap, where ice meets fire; dawn; 0 present then Ymir

beats.text: and out of the drops comes a giant named Ymir.
beats.shot: wide: a vast pale blue giant with a white beard rising from the melt water, ice around his shoulders
beats.state: the gap, where ice meets fire; dawn; 0 present then Ymir

beats.text: Beside him, a cow named Audhumla comes out of the same melting ice.
beats.shot: medium: Audhumla stepping out of dripping ice, the giant behind her
beats.state: the ice field; dawn; 2 present: Ymir (scale 4.0), Audhumla

beats.text: Ymir lives on her milk, and she lives on salty ice.
beats.shot: close: Ymir drinking milk from a stream, Audhumla licking a block of ice, side by side
beats.state: the ice field; dawn; 2 present: Ymir (scale 4.0), Audhumla

beats.text: By the third day, she has licked a whole man out of the ice.
beats.shot: medium: Audhumla licking a block of ice, a man's face and shoulders showing in it
beats.state: the ice field; dawn; 1 present: Audhumla licking; a figure forming in the ice
beats.trace: Gylf 6 V (Buri on the third day)

beats.text: That man's grandsons are Odin and two brothers, Vili and Ve.
beats.shot: medium: Odin (one eye, wide hat) flanked by two bare-headed brown-bearded brothers in green and yellow cloaks, walking forward
beats.state: the ice field; dawn; 3 present: Odin, Vili, Ve; the three walk toward camera

beats.text: So they kill Ymir.
beats.shot: wide: the three brothers in front, Ymir toppling backward behind them, spears in his chest
beats.state: the ice field; dawn; 4 present: Odin, Vili, Ve, Ymir; Ymir falls

beats.text: His blood pours out in such a flood that nearly every frost giant drowns.
beats.shot: wide: a red flood sweeping across the ice field, tiny blue giants swept away
beats.state: the ice field; dawn; 0 foreground figures; Ymir's body lying in the distance; a crowd of tiny frost giants swept off by a red flood

beats.text: The brothers drag the body into the middle of the gap,
beats.shot: wide: three brothers hauling the enormous body across the pale gap on ropes
beats.state: the empty gap; dawn; 4 present: Odin, Vili, Ve, Ymir's body; brothers drag the body

beats.text: and build a world out of it.
beats.shot: wide: the huge body lying in the gap, the brothers small on its chest looking down
beats.state: the empty gap; dawn; 4 present: Odin, Vili, Ve, Ymir's body; brothers drag the body

beats.text: His flesh becomes the land,
beats.shot: medium: brothers standing on brown earth shaped like a huge shoulder
beats.state: Ymir's body, now land; dawn; 3 present: Odin, Vili, Ve, standing on the ground

beats.text: his blood becomes the sea,
beats.shot: medium: a blue sea washing against the brown earth
beats.state: Ymir's body, now land; dawn; 3 present: Odin, Vili, Ve, standing on the ground

beats.text: his bones become the mountains,
beats.shot: medium: grey stone peaks rising where the ribs were
beats.state: Ymir's body, now land; dawn; 3 present: Odin, Vili, Ve, standing on the ground

beats.text: and his hair becomes the trees.
beats.shot: medium: green forest sprouting along the hills
beats.state: Ymir's body, now land; dawn; 3 present: Odin, Vili, Ve, standing on the ground

beats.text: His skull becomes the sky, held up by four dwarfs.
beats.shot: wide: a vast curved skull-shaped dome over the land, a small bearded dwarf at each of the four corners holding it up
beats.state: the new world; dawn; 7 present: Odin, Vili, Ve, four dwarfs; dwarfs at the four corners
beats.trace: Grimnismal 40 (skull as sky) V; Gylf 8 (four dwarfs, East, West, North, South) V

beats.text: Sparks from the fire land are thrown up there as stars.
beats.shot: wide, night: the three brothers with arms raised, bright sparks flying up into a dark dome
beats.state: the sky; night; 3 present: Odin, Vili, Ve, hands raised

beats.text: Not bad for three brothers.
beats.shot: medium, night: Odin, one eye, looking up with a small satisfied smile
beats.state: the sky; night; 3 present: Odin, Vili, Ve, hands raised
beats.trace: (ours) dry beat; the three brothers are Gylf 6-8

title: The Tree That Held Nine Worlds

beats.text: The brothers need someone to live in it.
beats.shot: medium, morning: the three brothers walking along a pale beach, looking around
beats.state: a beach on Midgard; morning; 3 present: Odin, Vili, Ve; they walk along the shore

beats.text: Along the shore they find two fallen trees.
beats.shot: medium: two driftwood trunks lying on the sand, the brothers stopping over them
beats.state: a beach on Midgard; morning; 3 present: Odin, Vili, Ve; they walk along the shore
beats.trace: Gylf 9 V (the two trees); Voluspa 17 has 'two without fate' and no trees

beats.text: They shape them into the first man and woman,
beats.shot: medium: two wooden trunks becoming figures, one man and one woman with leaf-green clothes, standing
beats.state: a beach on Midgard; morning; 5 present: Odin, Vili, Ve, Ask, Embla; the pair stand up

beats.text: Ask and Embla.
beats.shot: close: the pair side by side, the man and the woman, wide-eyed
beats.state: a beach on Midgard; morning; 5 present: Odin, Vili, Ve, Ask, Embla; the pair stand up

beats.text: Odin gives them breath,
beats.shot: close: Odin breathing toward the woman's face as her eyes open
beats.state: a beach on Midgard; morning; 5 present: Odin, Vili, Ve, Ask, Embla; the pair stand up

beats.text: and their world is called Midgard, the middle world.
beats.shot: wide: a green land ringed by a blue sea, the pair tiny at its center
beats.state: a beach on Midgard; morning; 5 present: Odin, Vili, Ve, Ask, Embla; the pair stand up

beats.text: Above it, the gods build their own home, Asgard,
beats.shot: wide, day: a golden-roofed hall on a high green hill above the clouds
beats.state: Asgard; day; 0 present; wide of a golden hall on a high green hill with a rainbow bridge

beats.text: and join the two with a rainbow bridge.
beats.shot: wide: a rainbow bridge arching from the hill down to the land below
beats.state: Asgard; day; 0 present; wide of a golden hall on a high green hill with a rainbow bridge

beats.text: Holding everything together is an enormous ash tree, Yggdrasil.
beats.shot: wide: a colossal ash tree, nine glowing lights in its branches, hills at its foot
beats.state: Yggdrasil; day; 0 present; slow pan up the trunk

beats.text: Its roots run down to the gods, the frost giants, and the dead.
beats.shot: medium: three huge roots, one into a golden land, one into a blue frozen land, one into a dark land
beats.state: Yggdrasil; day; 0 present; slow pan up the trunk

beats.text: An eagle sits at the top.
beats.shot: close: a huge eagle perched in the topmost branches
beats.state: Yggdrasil; day; 3 present: an eagle, a dragon, a squirrel; creatures at their places

beats.text: A dragon gnaws at the bottom.
beats.shot: close: a dark dragon chewing a root at the foot of the tree
beats.state: Yggdrasil; day; 3 present: an eagle, a dragon, a squirrel; creatures at their places

beats.text: And a squirrel runs between them, carrying insults.
beats.shot: medium: a squirrel racing up the trunk with a little scroll in its mouth
beats.state: Yggdrasil; day; 3 present: an eagle, a dragon, a squirrel; creatures at their places

beats.text: At the well of Mimir, Odin trades one eye for a drink.
beats.shot: close, dusk: Odin's hand lowering a glowing eye into the dark well
beats.state: Mimir's well; dusk; 1 present: Odin; Odin leans toward the water
beats.trace: Voluspa 28-29 V; Gylf 15 V (Mimir keeps the well; Brodeur does not call him a giant)

beats.text: That is why Odin has one eye, a wide hat, and a lot of secrets.
beats.shot: medium, firelight: Odin seated, wide hat, one eye, a dark empty socket
beats.state: Asgard hall; night; 1 present: Odin; he looks at the camera
beats.trace: (ours) one eye Voluspa 29 and Gylf 15 V; wide hat = Odin's name Sidhottr 'With Broad Hat', Grimnismal 48 V; 'a lot of secrets' is our joke

beats.text: Then Loki walks in.
beats.shot: medium, day: a green-cloaked figure with spiky black hair and a wide grin stepping through the hall door, Odin at the far end
beats.state: Asgard hall; day; 2 present: Odin, Loki; Loki walks in

title: The Wolf Everyone Agreed to Chain

beats.text: Loki is a giant's son who lives among the gods.
beats.shot: close, day: Loki alone, green cloak, spiky black hair, wide grin
beats.state: Asgard hall; day; 1 present: Loki; he grins at camera
beats.trace: Gylf 33 V (son of the giant Farbauti)

beats.text: He is handsome, charming, and impossible to trust.
beats.shot: medium, day: Loki leaning on a pillar, one eyebrow raised
beats.state: Asgard hall; day; 1 present: Loki; he grins at camera

beats.text: In the land of the giants, he has three children.
beats.shot: medium, night: Loki beside a blue giantess in a dark hut, a wooden cradle by the fire
beats.state: Jotunheim hut; night; 2 present: Loki, a giantess (Angrboda); they stand side by side beside a cradle

beats.text: The first is a wolf named Fenrir.
beats.shot: close: a grey wolf cub with bright white teeth
beats.state: Jotunheim; night; 3 present: Fenrir (cub), Jormungandr (small serpent), Hel (child); lined up

beats.text: The second is a serpent named Jormungandr.
beats.shot: close: a small green serpent with ring patterns, coiled
beats.state: Jotunheim; night; 3 present: Fenrir (cub), Jormungandr (small serpent), Hel (child); lined up

beats.text: The third is a girl named Hel, half dark and half pale.
beats.shot: close: a child with her face split down the middle, left half black, right half white
beats.state: Jotunheim; night; 3 present: Fenrir (cub), Jormungandr (small serpent), Hel (child); lined up

beats.text: The gods hear a prophecy that these three will bring them harm,
beats.shot: medium: Odin in the hall, frowning, one hand raised
beats.state: Asgard; day; 1 present: Odin; Odin looks down

beats.text: and Odin acts.
beats.shot: close: Odin's face, one eye hard
beats.state: Asgard; day; 1 present: Odin; Odin looks down

beats.text: He throws the serpent into the deep sea,
beats.shot: wide: Odin on a shore flinging a small green serpent far out over the waves
beats.state: sea; day; 2 present: Odin, the serpent; Odin throws, serpent falls

beats.text: and it grows until it circles the whole world, biting its own tail.
beats.shot: wide: a huge green serpent ring surrounding a small green round world in a blue sea, tail in mouth
beats.state: sea; day; 2 present: Odin, the serpent; Odin throws, serpent falls

beats.text: He sends Hel to the land of the dead, and gives her charge of it.
beats.shot: medium: the child Hel standing before a black stone gate, Odin's hand on her shoulder
beats.state: Hel; day; 2 present: Odin, Hel; Hel stands in front of a dark gate

beats.text: The gods keep the wolf close,
beats.shot: medium: a grey wolf the size of a pony pacing on the grass of Asgard
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 1 present: Fenrir (young); he paces

beats.text: and only Tyr dares to feed him.
beats.shot: medium: Tyr holding out a slab of meat to the wolf, other hand behind his back
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 2 present: Fenrir (young), Tyr; Tyr feeds Fenrir

beats.text: Fenrir grows fast, so the gods decide to chain him.
beats.shot: wide: the wolf now twice Tyr's height, jaws open, Tyr small beside him
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 2 present: Fenrir (huge, 2.0), Tyr

beats.text: They offer him a chain as a game of strength,
beats.shot: medium: Odin and Thor holding a thick chain toward the wolf, smiling too widely
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 3 present: Fenrir, Odin, Thor; the gods hold up a chain

beats.text: and he snaps it like thread.
beats.shot: close: the chain bursting into pieces across the wolf's chest, sparks
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 3 present: Fenrir, Odin, Thor; the gods hold up a chain

beats.text: A heavier chain breaks too.
beats.shot: medium: a thicker chain bursting apart, the gods stepping back
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 3 present: Fenrir, Odin, Thor; the gods hold up a chain

beats.text: So the gods send to the dwarfs, who make a cord called Gleipnir.
beats.shot: medium, firelit: two small bearded dwarfs at a bench pulling a long thin pale ribbon between them
beats.state: dwarf forge; night; 2 present: two dwarfs; they hammer at a bench
beats.trace: Gylf 34 V (Brodeur: 'fetter named Gleipnir', 'soft and smooth as a silken ribbon'; Skirnir is sent)

beats.text: It is made of six things: the sound of a cat's step, a woman's beard,
beats.shot: close: the dwarfs' hands dropping a few faint curved sound-lines for a cat's soft step, then a curl of beard, into a pot
beats.state: dwarf forge; night; 2 present: two dwarfs; they hammer at a bench
beats.trace: Gylf 34 V (noise a cat makes in foot-fall; beard of a woman)

beats.text: a mountain's roots, a bear's sinews, a fish's breath, and a bird's spit.
beats.shot: close: three more items in the pot: a root, a sinew, a bubble
beats.state: dwarf forge; night; 2 present: two dwarfs; they hammer at a bench
beats.trace: Gylf 34 V (Brodeur: roots of a rock; Bellows note on Voluspa 39 quotes 'roots of mountains')

beats.text: It looks like a silk ribbon.
beats.shot: close: the pale ribbon laid across one dwarf's palm
beats.state: dwarf forge; night; 2 present: two dwarfs; they hammer at a bench

beats.text: Fenrir smells a trick, and agrees on one condition:
beats.shot: medium: the wolf with jaws slightly open, the ribbon laid on the grass
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 4 present: Fenrir, Odin, Thor, Tyr; they stand in a half circle

beats.text: one of the gods must put a hand in his mouth.
beats.shot: close: the wolf's open jaws, teeth white, a hand-sized gap in the dark
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 4 present: Fenrir, Odin, Thor, Tyr; they stand in a half circle

beats.text: The gods look at one another. Who will risk it?
beats.shot: medium: Odin and Thor glancing sideways at each other, silent
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 4 present: Fenrir, Odin, Thor, Tyr; Odin and Thor look away, Tyr steps forward

beats.text: Tyr steps forward,
beats.shot: medium: Tyr walking forward alone, the wolf in front of him
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 4 present: Fenrir, Odin, Thor, Tyr; Odin and Thor look away, Tyr steps forward

beats.text: and puts his right hand between the wolf's jaws.
beats.shot: close: Tyr's right hand resting inside the open jaws, his face calm
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 4 present: Fenrir, Odin, Thor, Tyr; Odin and Thor look away, Tyr steps forward

beats.text: The ribbon goes on, and the harder Fenrir pulls, the tighter it holds.
beats.shot: wide, dusk: the wolf bound by the pale ribbon, straining, the gods stepping back
beats.state: Fenrir's rock; dusk; 4 present: Fenrir, Odin, Thor, Tyr; the wolf strains, ribbon tightens

beats.text: The gods laugh, all except Tyr.
beats.shot: medium: Odin and Thor laughing, Tyr beside them not laughing
beats.state: Fenrir's rock; dusk; 4 present: Fenrir, Odin, Thor, Tyr; the wolf strains, ribbon tightens

beats.text: Fenrir bites the hand off,
beats.shot: close: the wolf's jaws closing on Tyr's wrist
beats.state: Fenrir's rock; dusk; 4 present: Fenrir, Odin, Thor, Tyr; the wolf strains, ribbon tightens

beats.text: and stays chained until the end of the world.
beats.shot: wide, dusk: the wolf bound on a flat rock, a sword propped in his jaws, the gods small beside him
beats.state: Fenrir's rock; dusk; 4 present: Fenrir, Odin, Thor, Tyr; the wolf strains, ribbon tightens

title: The Day Thor Went Fishing for a Serpent

beats.text: Thor is the god of thunder, strongest of them all, with a hammer named Mjolnir.
beats.shot: medium, day: Thor, red beard, red cape, holding a stubby hammer on his shoulder
beats.state: Asgard; day; 1 present: Thor; Thor stands with the hammer
beats.trace: Gylf 21 V (strongest of all gods and men; Mjollnir). 'God of thunder' is the standard description, not a word in Gylf 21. Red beard not in Brodeur or Bellows: visual design only, never narrated

beats.text: One day he sets out to find the serpent,
beats.shot: wide: Thor walking along a hill road toward a distant blue sea
beats.state: a road through hills; day; 1 present: Thor; he walks in disguise, no beard visible

beats.text: disguised as a young man.
beats.shot: medium: Thor in a plain brown cloak with his red beard covered by a hood
beats.state: a road through hills; day; 1 present: Thor; he walks in disguise, no beard visible

beats.text: He comes to a giant named Hymir,
beats.shot: medium: Thor small in front of a huge bearded giant holding a fishing net
beats.state: Hymir's farm; day; 2 present: Thor, Hymir (scale 3.0); Hymir looks down at Thor

beats.text: who does not think the stranger will be much use on a boat.
beats.shot: close: Hymir looking down, one eyebrow raised
beats.state: Hymir's farm; day; 2 present: Thor, Hymir (scale 3.0); Hymir looks down at Thor

beats.text: Thor takes the head of the biggest ox on the farm for bait.
beats.shot: medium: Thor carrying a huge brown ox head by its horns, Hymir staring
beats.state: Hymir's farm; day; 2 present: Thor, Hymir; Thor carries an ox head

beats.text: They row out, and Hymir says they are far enough,
beats.shot: wide, morning: a small wooden boat on a calm blue sea, two figures, the shore a thin line
beats.state: a small boat at sea; morning; 2 present: Thor, Hymir; Thor rows, Hymir sits

beats.text: but Thor says row further.
beats.shot: medium: Thor at the oars, Hymir pointing back toward land
beats.state: a small boat at sea; morning; 2 present: Thor, Hymir; Thor rows, Hymir sits

beats.text: Hymir grows pale.
beats.shot: close: Hymir's face, pale and anxious, sea behind
beats.state: a small boat at sea; morning; 2 present: Thor, Hymir; Thor rows, Hymir sits

beats.text: Thor ties the ox head to a hook,
beats.shot: medium: Thor tying the ox head to a heavy rope with a huge hook
beats.state: a small boat at sea; midday; 2 present: Thor, Hymir; Thor ties bait to a heavy line

beats.text: and throws it into the deep,
beats.shot: wide: the ox head sinking into dark water, a line trailing to the boat
beats.state: a small boat at sea; midday; 2 present: Thor, Hymir; Thor ties bait to a heavy line

beats.text: and the serpent bites.
beats.shot: close: the water bubbling, the line pulled tight over the side
beats.state: a small boat at sea; midday; 2 present: Thor, Hymir; Thor ties bait to a heavy line

beats.text: Thor pulls so hard his feet go through the bottom of the boat,
beats.shot: medium: Thor hauling the line, his boots punching through the planks into the sea
beats.state: a small boat at sea; midday; 2 present: Thor, Hymir; Thor braces

beats.text: and he braces himself on the sea floor.
beats.shot: close: Thor's boots planted on sand under clear water, the boat above
beats.state: a small boat at sea; midday; 2 present: Thor, Hymir; Thor braces

beats.text: The serpent rises, and the two of them stare at each other.
beats.shot: wide: a huge green serpent head rising over the side, Thor facing it, red beard visible again
beats.state: a small boat at sea; midday; 3 present: Thor, Hymir, the serpent; serpent head rises

beats.text: Water pours in, Hymir panics,
beats.shot: close: Hymir with a knife in his fist, water at his ankles
beats.state: a small boat at sea; midday; 3 present: Thor, Hymir, the serpent; Hymir with a knife

beats.text: and Thor lifts his hammer.
beats.shot: close: Thor's raised hammer, arm cocked back
beats.state: a small boat at sea; midday; 3 present: Thor, Hymir, the serpent; Hymir with a knife

beats.text: Hymir cuts the line.
beats.shot: close: Hymir's knife slicing the rope, the ends flying
beats.state: a small boat at sea; midday; 3 present: Thor, Hymir, the serpent; Hymir with a knife

beats.text: The serpent sinks back into the sea,
beats.shot: wide: the green serpent head slipping beneath the waves, a ring of foam
beats.state: a small boat at sea; midday; 3 present: Thor, Hymir, the serpent; serpent sinks

beats.text: and Thor throws the hammer after it.
beats.shot: medium: Thor flinging the hammer, mid-air, toward the foam
beats.state: a small boat at sea; midday; 3 present: Thor, Hymir, the serpent; serpent sinks

beats.text: Thor knocks Hymir overboard, and wades ashore.
beats.shot: wide, dusk: Hymir splashing in shallow water, Thor striding to the beach with the hammer
beats.state: the shore; evening; 2 present: Thor, Hymir; Thor strikes

beats.text: Round one is a draw, but they will meet again.
beats.shot: medium, dusk: Thor alone on the beach, hammer down, looking at a dark sea
beats.state: the shore; dusk; 1 present: Thor; he looks at the sea

beats.text: Baldr is the best loved of the gods,
beats.shot: medium, day: a white-haired figure in a glowing gold tunic, arms open, light all around him
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 1 present: Baldr; he stands in the sun

beats.text: so fair and bright that light seems to shine from him.
beats.shot: close: Baldr's face, white hair, a soft gold glow
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 1 present: Baldr; he stands in the sun

beats.text: Then he begins to dream about his own death.
beats.shot: medium, night: Baldr sitting up in bed, eyes wide, hands to his chest
beats.state: Baldr's bed; night; 1 present: Baldr; he sits up

beats.text: His mother, Frigg, goes to everything in the world
beats.shot: medium, day: a woman in a long blue dress with a white headdress, walking quickly through a field
beats.state: a meadow; day; 1 present: Frigg; she hurries

beats.text: and asks for a promise.
beats.shot: wide: Frigg bending before a river, a rock, and a tree in turn
beats.state: a meadow; day; 1 present: Frigg; she hurries

beats.text: Fire, water, iron, stone, trees, sickness, poison, beasts, birds.
beats.shot: medium: a row of five small objects: a flame, a wave, a sword, a rock, a tree, lined up before her
beats.state: a meadow; day; 1 present: Frigg; she hurries

beats.text: Every one swears not to harm Baldr.
beats.shot: close: Frigg and a small flame, the flame bowing
beats.state: a meadow; day; 1 present: Frigg; she hurries

beats.text: The gods are so relieved that they turn it into a game.
beats.shot: wide, day: Baldr standing in the middle of a ring, Odin, Thor and Loki around him, Thor holding a rock
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 4 present: Baldr, Odin, Thor, Loki; gods throw things

beats.text: Nothing touches him.
beats.shot: medium: an axe bouncing off Baldr's chest, Baldr smiling
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 4 present: Baldr, Odin, Thor, Loki; gods throw things

beats.text: Everyone cheers, except Loki.
beats.shot: medium: Odin and Thor cheering, Loki alone with arms folded, scowling
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 4 present: Baldr, Odin, Thor, Loki; gods throw things

beats.text: Loki puts on the shape of a woman and visits Frigg.
beats.shot: medium, dusk: a green-cloaked figure in a woman's shawl, with spiky black hair showing, knocking at a wooden door
beats.state: Fensalir; dusk; 2 present: Frigg, Loki as an old woman; Loki talks, Frigg answers

beats.text: He asks if truly everything promised.
beats.shot: close: the shawled face leaning close to Frigg, eyes sly
beats.state: Fensalir; dusk; 2 present: Frigg, Loki as an old woman; Loki talks, Frigg answers

beats.text: Frigg says only one plant, a little mistletoe, was too young to ask.
beats.shot: medium: Frigg gesturing to a tiny green sprig growing on an oak
beats.state: Fensalir; dusk; 2 present: Frigg, Loki as an old woman; Loki talks, Frigg answers

beats.text: Loki goes straight out and pulls it up.
beats.shot: medium, dusk: Loki yanking a sprig of mistletoe from an oak, grinning
beats.state: an oak, dusk; 1 present: Loki; Loki pulls

beats.text: How do you hurt a god that nothing can hurt?
beats.shot: wide, day: Baldr alone in a ring, the others small around him, a sprig of mistletoe in the foreground
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 5 present: Baldr, Odin, Thor, Hod, Loki; Hod holds the sprig

beats.text: At the edge of the game stands the blind god Hod, with nothing to throw.
beats.shot: medium: a plain grey-cloaked god with white blank eyes standing outside the ring, hands empty
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 5 present: Baldr, Odin, Thor, Hod, Loki; Hod holds the sprig

beats.text: Loki puts the mistletoe in his hand, and points him at Baldr.
beats.shot: close: Loki's hand placing a sprig in Hod's palm, turning his shoulders
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 5 present: Baldr, Odin, Thor, Hod, Loki; Hod holds the sprig

beats.text: Hod throws.
beats.shot: close: Hod's arm swinging, mistletoe in flight
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 5 present: Baldr, Odin, Thor, Hod, Loki; Hod holds the sprig

beats.text: The mistletoe goes straight through Baldr, and he falls dead.
beats.shot: medium: Baldr crumpling to the grass, the sprig lying beside him, gods frozen
beats.state: Asgard grounds; day; 5 present: Baldr, Odin, Thor, Hod, Loki; Hod holds the sprig

beats.text: Odin's son rides to Hel, and begs her to give him back.
beats.shot: medium, dusk: a lone hooded rider on a grey horse at a black stone gate, Hel's split-faced figure beyond it
beats.state: Hel's gate; dusk; 2 present: Hel, a hooded rider (Hermod, Odin's son, unnamed); the rider pleads
beats.trace: Gylf 49 V (Hermod, Odin's son, rides to Hel; he is not named in the narration)

beats.text: She says yes, if every living thing weeps for him.
beats.shot: close: Hel's split face, arms folded
beats.state: Hel's gate; dusk; 2 present: Hel, a hooded rider (Hermod, Odin's son, unnamed); the rider pleads

beats.text: Everything weeps, even the rocks and the iron,
beats.shot: wide: a rock, a tree, a sword, all leaking tears
beats.state: the world; day; 0 figures; a rock, a tree and a sword in tears

beats.text: except one giantess, who says she will not.
beats.shot: medium: a lone blue giantess sitting in a cave, turning her face away
beats.state: a cave; day; 1 present: the giantess Thokk; she turns away

beats.text: Some say it was Loki in disguise.
beats.shot: close: the giantess's face, one eyebrow raised, a flash of a grin
beats.state: a cave; day; 1 present: the giantess Thokk; she turns away

beats.text: Baldr stays dead.
beats.shot: close: Baldr on a burning ship, hands on chest
beats.state: a burning ship at sea; dusk; 1 present: Baldr (dead); the ship drifts out

beats.text: The gods catch Loki at last, hiding as a salmon.
beats.shot: wide: a silver salmon leaping in a waterfall, Odin and Thor pulling a net
beats.state: a waterfall; day; 3 present: Loki as a salmon, Odin, Thor; net comes down

beats.text: They bind him to three rocks,
beats.shot: wide, dark: Loki tied across three rocks in a cave
beats.state: a dark cave; night; 1 present: Loki, tied across three rocks

beats.text: and hang a serpent above his face, dripping venom.
beats.shot: close: a serpent coiled on the cave roof, drops falling toward Loki's face
beats.state: a dark cave; night; 2 present: Loki (bound), a serpent on the roof

beats.text: His wife, Sigyn, holds a bowl to catch the drops.
beats.shot: medium: a woman in a plain brown dress holding a wooden bowl above Loki's face
beats.state: a dark cave; night; 3 present: Loki (bound), serpent, Sigyn; Sigyn holds the bowl

beats.text: When the bowl is full, she has to empty it,
beats.shot: medium: Sigyn walking toward the cave mouth with the bowl
beats.state: a dark cave; night; 3 present: Loki (bound), serpent, Sigyn; Sigyn holds the bowl

beats.text: and the venom lands on him, and the earth shakes.
beats.shot: wide: Loki arching in his bonds, cracks running through the cave walls
beats.state: a dark cave; night; 3 present: Loki (bound), serpent, Sigyn; Sigyn holds the bowl

beats.text: He lies there until the end of the world.
beats.shot: wide: the cave, a long shot of Loki, Sigyn, and the serpent in silence
beats.state: a dark cave; night; 3 present: Loki (bound), serpent, Sigyn; Sigyn holds the bowl

title: Everyone Dies, Then the World Begins Again

beats.text: The end begins with a winter.
beats.shot: wide, dusk: snow falling over a dark green world, a pale sun
beats.state: the world; dusk; 0 present; snow

beats.text: It lasts three winters, with no summer between.
beats.shot: wide: three winter scenes in a row, the same hill under snow
beats.state: the world; dusk; 0 present; snow

beats.text: Then wolves swallow the sun and the moon.
beats.shot: wide, night: a huge grey wolf with jaws over a white disc, another wolf near a pale moon
beats.state: the sky; night; 2 present: two wolves; wolves leap

beats.text: The stars go out, the earth shakes, and every chain breaks.
beats.shot: wide, night: a black sky, cracks across a hill, a chain falling apart
beats.state: the sky; night; 2 present: two wolves; wolves leap

beats.text: Fenrir runs free, his jaws open from the earth to the sky.
beats.shot: wide, night: the huge grey wolf standing up, jaws open from ground to clouds
beats.state: Fenrir's rock; night; 1 present: Fenrir; Fenrir rises

beats.text: The serpent twists out of the sea, and the waves flood the land.
beats.shot: wide: the green ring serpent rising, water over the beaches
beats.state: the sea; night; 1 present: the serpent; it rises

beats.text: A ship built of dead men's fingernails sails in.
beats.shot: wide: a pale ship with a ragged sail moving across a grey sea
beats.state: the sea; night; 0 figures; a pale ship (empty)

beats.text: The sons of Muspell ride from the south, led by Surt, with a flaming sword.
beats.shot: wide, night: a huge black figure carrying a sword of flame, red riders behind
beats.state: the sky; night; 1 present: Surt (scale 4.0); sky splits
beats.trace: Gylf 51 V; Voluspa 52 V (Brodeur: 'Sons of Muspell'; they are not called giants)

beats.text: The watchman of the gods, Heimdall, blows his horn.
beats.shot: close, night: a white-cloaked figure raising a golden horn to the sky
beats.state: Asgard wall; night; 1 present: Heimdall; Heimdall raises a horn

beats.text: The gods arm themselves and ride out to the plain.
beats.shot: wide, night: three tiny armored figures marching across a dark plain, red sky
beats.state: Vigrid plain; night; 3 present: Odin, Thor, Tyr; gods arm

beats.text: The wolf goes for Odin and swallows him.
beats.shot: medium: Fenrir's huge jaws closing on Odin, hat flying off
beats.state: Vigrid plain; night; 2 present: Odin, Fenrir; the wolf lunges
beats.trace: Gylf 51 V ('The Wolf shall swallow Odin')

beats.text: Odin's son Vidar puts one boot on the wolf's jaw,
beats.shot: close: Vidar, a stone-faced young god in a big iron boot, stepping on the jaw
beats.state: Vigrid plain; night; 2 present: Vidar, Fenrir (Odin gone); Vidar steps on the jaw
beats.trace: Gylf 51 V (Vidar sets one foot on the lower jaw)

beats.text: and tears the wolf's throat apart.
beats.shot: medium: Vidar pulling the jaws wide, Fenrir collapsing
beats.state: Vigrid plain; night; 2 present: Vidar, Fenrir (Odin gone); Vidar steps on the jaw
beats.trace: Gylf 51 V (Prose Edda: tears the gullet asunder; Voluspa 54 has a sword to the heart, not used)

beats.text: Thor meets the serpent at last, and kills it.
beats.shot: wide: Thor raising the hammer, a green serpent head over him, a bolt of lightning
beats.state: Vigrid plain; night; 2 present: Thor, the serpent; Thor strikes

beats.text: Then he walks nine steps, and falls dead from the venom.
beats.shot: medium: Thor taking nine steps away from the dead serpent, then dropping
beats.state: Vigrid plain; night; 2 present: Thor, the serpent; Thor strikes

beats.text: Tyr and a hound named Garm kill each other.
beats.shot: medium: Tyr and a black hound locked together, both falling
beats.state: Vigrid plain; night; 2 present: Tyr, Garm; they fall together

beats.text: So do Heimdall and Loki, free at last.
beats.shot: medium: Heimdall and Loki locked in a struggle, both falling
beats.state: Vigrid plain; night; 2 present: Heimdall, Loki; they fall together

beats.text: Then Surt flings fire across the earth.
beats.shot: wide: Surt swinging a flaming sword over all, the land burning
beats.state: the world; night; 1 present: Surt; Surt swings
beats.trace: Gylf 51 V ('burn all the world'); Voluspa 52, 57 V

beats.text: The earth sinks into the sea.
beats.shot: wide: a burning hill sliding into a black sea
beats.state: the world; night; 1 present: Surt; Surt swings

beats.text: And then, silence.
beats.shot: wide, night: a black sea, no land
beats.state: an empty sea; night; 0 present; stillness

beats.text: But the story does not end there.
beats.shot: wide, dawn: a small green hill rising out of calm water
beats.state: a green hill; dawn; 0 present; green rises

beats.text: The earth rises again from the sea, green and new.
beats.shot: wide: green hills rising from calm blue water
beats.state: a green hill; dawn; 0 present; green rises

beats.text: Fields grow without anyone sowing them.
beats.shot: wide: a golden field of grain, nobody in sight
beats.state: a green hill; dawn; 0 present; green rises

beats.text: A few gods survive, and Thor's sons carry his hammer.
beats.shot: medium, day: Vidar standing, two young gods beside him holding a hammer between them
beats.state: the hill; day; 3 present: Vidar, Modi, Magni; the two sons hold Mjolnir

beats.text: Baldr and Hod come back from the dead.
beats.shot: medium: Baldr in his gold tunic and Hod in grey, walking over the green hill together
beats.state: the hill; day; 2 present: Baldr, Hod; they walk together

beats.text: One man and one woman step out of a forest,
beats.shot: medium: a man and woman in leaf-green clothes coming out of the trees, blinking
beats.state: a forest; dawn; 2 present: Lif, Lifthrasir; they step out

beats.text: where they hid and lived on morning dew.
beats.shot: close: the pair licking dew from a leaf
beats.state: a forest; dawn; 2 present: Lif, Lifthrasir; they step out

beats.text: They begin again.
beats.shot: wide, dawn: a small green world, the pair at its center, the sun rising
beats.state: a forest; dawn; 2 present: Lif, Lifthrasir; they step out

title: The Christian Who Saved the Gods

beats.text: So how do we know any of this?
beats.shot: medium, night: a bearded poet by a fire in a turf hall, three listeners, one raising a hand to ask
beats.state: a hall in Iceland; night; 4 present: a poet, three listeners; the poet speaks

beats.text: None of this was written down when the poems were first made.
beats.shot: medium, night: a bearded poet by a fire in a turf hall, three listeners
beats.state: a hall in Iceland; night; 4 present: a poet, three listeners; the poet speaks
beats.trace: (ours) basis: Bellows, Voluspa introductory note ('two hundred years between its composition and its first being committed to writing') V; Bellows general introduction (collections written by the 12th century)

beats.text: For generations it was recited from memory by poets.
beats.shot: medium: the poet reciting with open hands, listeners leaning in
beats.state: a hall in Iceland; night; 4 present: a poet, three listeners; the poet speaks
beats.trace: (ours) basis: Bellows (as above); 'winter nights' dropped, no source

beats.text: Most of the poems survive in one great book, the Codex Regius, from about twelve seventy.
beats.shot: medium, day: a scribe at a slanted desk copying onto calfskin
beats.state: a scriptorium in Iceland; day; 1 present: a scribe; he writes
beats.trace: Codex Regius (GKS 2365 4to), 1270s (Wikipedia, Codex Regius; sole source for most of its poems) V; Bellows intro: other poems survive elsewhere (AM 748, Hauksbok)

beats.text: It was written in Iceland, by Christians, about gods nobody worshipped anymore.
beats.shot: close: the scribe's hand writing, a small wooden cross on the wall
beats.state: a scriptorium in Iceland; day; 1 present: a scribe; he writes
beats.trace: (ours) Iceland legally Christian in 1000 (Wikipedia, Christianization of Iceland) V; Bellows intro: Regius is a copy made about a hundred years after the 12th-century collections

beats.text: Around twelve twenty, an Icelandic chieftain named Snorri Sturluson put together a handbook for poets.
beats.shot: medium, day: a man in a long dark blue robe holding a quill, a stack of calfskin pages
beats.state: Reykholt study; day; 1 present: Snorri; he writes
beats.trace: Prose Edda c. 1220 (Wikipedia, Prose Edda: 'to some extent written, or at least compiled, by Snorri c. 1220'); Brodeur intro: a book for apprentice poets V

beats.text: Snorri was a Christian too,
beats.shot: medium: Snorri at his desk, a cross hung on a cord around his neck
beats.state: Reykholt study; day; 1 present: Snorri; he writes
beats.trace: (ours) basis: Brodeur intro (Snorri's address to beginners: the tales are 'neither to be believed nor to be tampered with'); Prologue opens with the Christian creation V

beats.text: and his book opens with Adam and Eve, then says the gods were once men from Asia.
beats.shot: medium: Snorri writing, a small drawing of a map beside him
beats.state: Reykholt study; day; 1 present: Snorri; he writes
beats.trace: Prose Edda Prologue (Brodeur p. 1-9: Adam and Eve, then the Aesir as men of Asia, from Troy) V; Brodeur intro: many scholars consider the Prologue spurious

beats.text: Not every source agrees.
beats.shot: close: two scrolls side by side on the desk
beats.state: Reykholt study; day; 1 present: Snorri; he writes

beats.text: In one poem, the makers of the first people have different names.
beats.shot: medium: three tiny god figures over two fallen trees in a margin drawing
beats.state: Reykholt study; day; 1 present: Snorri; he writes

beats.text: When they disagree, we follow Snorri.
beats.shot: close: Snorri's finger resting on one page
beats.state: Reykholt study; day; 1 present: Snorri; he writes

beats.text: He was killed in twelve forty-one, on the orders of a Norwegian king.
beats.shot: medium, dusk: Snorri seated with his back to us, the long shadow of a man with a spear falling across the doorway
beats.state: Reykholt study; day; 1 present: Snorri; he writes
beats.trace: Brodeur intro (Gizurr Thorvaldsson, 1241, 'at the express order of the King', Hakon Hakonarson) V; Wikipedia, Snorri: 23 Sept 1241, Reykholt, killed in the cellar

beats.text: A world made from a giant, ended by a wolf, and begun again.
beats.shot: wide, dawn: the green hill with the pair in the distance and the great tree behind them
beats.state: Reykholt study; day; 1 present: Snorri; he writes

beats.text: We only know it because somebody wrote it down.
beats.shot: close: Snorri's quill touching the page
beats.state: Reykholt study; day; 1 present: Snorri; he writes
